sessions.summary: Shipped currency normalization (#252) to production via PR #275 after discovering it was on develop but not main. Completed SHOP 40-F spike (#267) — discovered companyconcept API returns 40-F revenue data back to 2017 while companyfacts blob excludes it entirely. Implemented fullHistory flag (#253) and removed client-side Firestore writes (#256). Created sub-issues #277/#278 for 40-F implementation. Fixed GITHUB_TOKEN mistake (must stay set for DubiWork ops).
key_decisions: GITHUB_TOKEN env var must stay set for DubiWork org operations
companyconcept API is authoritative for 40-F revenue data
fullHistory flag defers UI wiring to #260
